gaps.term: Bounded scans to move one radix digit
gaps.quote: so moving one digit takes a bounded number of scans.
gaps.note: The reader has not studied tape-level data-movement algorithms, and the page gives no method for moving a fixed-size block with scans. The reason offered (the block fits in the finite control) does not show how the block is carried or shifted past other cells, so the bounded-scan claim cannot be checked from the page.
